biotools.summary: This tool calculates segmentation metrics (Dice score, intersection over union, Hausdorff distance, and normalised surface distance) between two sets of masks. It can be used to quickly calculate a number of metrics for segmentation models.

function.cmd:
uv run eval_segmentation \
    --pred test_data/predicted/ \
    --gt test_data/groundtruth/ \
    --output test.json \
    --n_classes 2 \
    --verbose \
    --params '{"normalised_surface_distance": {"max_distance": 100.0}}'
function.note: This is the core command which can be used to calculate image segmentation metrics. For more options please run `uv run eval_segmentation --help`

biotools.name: Segmentation evaluation
